metadata.description: The neurotech workflow suite for Claude: 32 skills in 5 bundles plus a router.

plugins.name: neuro-router
plugins.description: Start here. Routes any neurotech or BCI request to the right Hillock skill, plus two foundation skills: reading every neural file format and finding public datasets.

plugins.name: neuro-decoding
plugins.description: Decoder evaluation workflows for BCI and neural data: leak-free splits, true chance levels, cross-day stability, dataset quirks, seizure and sleep scoring, foundation-model comparisons.

plugins.name: neuro-signal
plugins.description: Signal-analysis workflows: EEG/MEG preprocessing, spike sorting and QC, noise diagnosis, channel-map checks, connectivity claims and cluster statistics, with tool references for MNE, EEGLAB, FieldTrip, Brainstorm, SpikeInterface, Kilosort 4 and Neuropixels.

plugins.name: neuro-realtime
plugins.description: Real-time and closed-loop BCI workflows: streaming pipelines, clock sync forensics, stimulus timing, phase-locked stimulation, artifact recovery and decoder-to-firmware ports, with tool references for LSL, BrainFlow, MNE-LSL, PsychoPy, Psychtoolbox, BCI2000 and OpenViBE.

plugins.name: neuro-stim
plugins.description: Neuromodulation research-engineering workflows: stimulation safety limits, TMS/tES field modeling, DBS sensing data, focused-ultrasound dosing, nerve-stimulation models and sham design, with tool references for SimNIBS, ROAST, Percept exports, Lead-DBS, k-Wave, BabelBrain, NEURON and ASCENT. Research support, not clinical decisions.

plugins.name: neuro-device
plugins.description: Neural-device engineering workflows: recording front ends, electrode electrochemistry, implant power and thermal budgets, regulatory test mapping and SOUP inventories, with references for ADS1299/Intan, potentiostat data and fitting, bioheat modelling, FDA databases (live openFDA lookup) and OSV vulnerability checks. Engineering support, not certification.
